question: How do I replace the air filter in my HVAC system?
answer: To replace the air filter, first switch off the power to the HVAC system at the circuit breaker. Open the filter compartment by releasing the latch and pulling it open. Remove the old filter and discard it. Install a new filter, making sure it is properly seated and the latch is secure. Then turn the power back on at the circuit breaker.

safety_info: Electrical shock hazard: switch off the power to the HVAC system at the circuit breaker before starting work. Inhalation of dust and debris: wear a dust mask when removing the old filter and cleaning the filter compartment.
tips: Use a filter with a MERV rating of 11 or higher for better air quality.
Consider installing a filter with a built-in antimicrobial treatment to reduce dust mites and other allergens.
